children: CrowdStrike expects its deal to buy Zscaler to eventually generate about $1 billion in annualized run-rate revenue synergies from deepening combined customer relationships, expanded cross-sell and upsell opportunities and integrated solutions. Wedbush analyst Steven Wahrhaftig says those targets look ambitious but achievable, noting the deal creates "a platform that can expand its reach across customer bases and provide its customers all necessary cyber capabilities to address the evolving threat landscape." Wahrhaftig notes that CrowdStrike expects to achieve $500 million in annualized run-rate cost synergies within 18 to 24 months following the deal's close, primarily through optimizing its data center infrastructure, vendors and broader operations. (kelly.cloonan@wsj.com)
